headline: InCred Equities recommends five stocks for Samvat 2083
hook: Brokerage targets up to 46 percent upside
summary: InCred Equities has released its top stock picks for Samvat 2083, naming RHI Magnesita India, CarTrade Tech, Artemis Medicare, Rolex Rings, and Lemon Tree Hotels. The brokerage forecasts an average upside of about 36 percent across these five counters. Projected gains range from 33 percent to 46 percent for four of the stocks, with Lemon Tree Hotels pegged at a 23 percent upside. Indian retail investors tracking institutional broker strategies can review these names for portfolio planning.
why_it_matters: Brokerage recommendations may drive near-term buying interest in these stocks.
winners_losers: Listed stock shareholders gain attention / unrated peers unaffected

headline: Anand Rathi initiates coverage on Artemis Medicare with buy rating
hook: Broker sees 20% upside for Artemis Medicare
summary: Brokerage firm Anand Rathi has issued a buy rating on Artemis Medicare Services. The firm has set a price target of Rs 390 per share. This recommendation reflects the broker's outlook on the company's growth potential within the healthcare sector.
why_it_matters: Potential price appreciation for existing shareholders of Artemis Medicare.

headline: Artemis Medicare Services reports Q2 FY27 financial results
hook: Revenue growth outpaces profit growth at Artemis
summary: Artemis Medicare Services posted a 13.2% year-on-year increase in consolidated revenue from operations for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027. Adjusted EBITDA grew 22.7% compared to the same period last year, while reported EBITDA rose 7.9%. Net profit for the quarter increased by 3.7% year-on-year. Retail investors in the healthcare sector can track these operating margins and earnings growth figures.
why_it_matters: Quarterly earnings shape sentiment for hospital stocks
winners_losers: Artemis holders gain / no clear losers

headline: Artemis Medicare Services files financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026
summary: Artemis Medicare Services Limited has formally submitted its financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, to the stock exchange. The filing provides the company's financial performance data for the specified period. Retail investors can review the reported numbers to assess the healthcare firm's revenue and profitability trends.
why_it_matters: Quarterly earnings data guides investor sentiment on Artemis Medicare.
